commits.subject: fix: enforce strict gate and snapshot integrity
fix: enforce knowledge management input and write boundaries
refactor: split strict production contracts by responsibility

integrationBoundary: Main currently supplies raw Core repository for knowledgeRepo; an explicit read/management adapter is still required for getById/reject/score/validate and Core service semantics. No neighboring repository was edited.
riskBoundaries: An external port that ignores cancellation may already have mutated its own state; Agent cancels its own continuation, not external rollback.
Write errors with partial or uncertain effects require Core readback/reconciliation; no automatic retry or fake unchanged lifecycle.
V1 hash encodings preserved; differing canonical helpers require protocol migration analysis before unification.
